_about: The npm advisories at HIGH or CRITICAL that are known, triaged and accepted, per package directory, each with the reason it is accepted. scripts/check-npm-advisories.mjs fails on any high or critical advisory NOT listed here, and warns on any entry here that no longer appears (remove it: an ignore that outlives its reason is worse than none). Triage of record: docs/security/SCANNER-TRIAGE-2026-10-11.md, section 4.1. Moderate and low advisories are reported by the workflow, never gated.

app.GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5: zod <4.6.6 (memory exhaustion validating oversized constrained collections), no fixed 3.x release; checked 2026-10-24. Three zod 3 copies remain (3.25.76, and 3.22.4 twice), each required as zod 3 by a wallet or payment library: Privy (@privy-io/api-base), Coinbase (@coinbase/cdp-sdk, x402), Reown/WalletConnect (@reown/appkit-wallet, pinned 3.22.4), and abitype. The fourth copy, under porto, was moved to 4.6.7 within its own range. Browser-only: the app imports none of these libraries (nor viem, wagmi or abitype) outside app/src/wallet/privy-bridge.tsx, which auth-provider.tsx loads with dynamic(..., { ssr: false }), and has no zod of its own, so nothing validates with it on the server; the worst case is a provider response that exhausts the visitor's own tab. Forcing zod 4 onto libraries that require ^3 would change their validation API. Cleared when those libraries move to zod 4.
app.GHSA-qr28-fpjm-wq7f: decode-uri-component <=0.5.0 (quadratic time decoding long runs of percent-encoded input), checked 2026-10-30. The one copy, 0.2.2, is required as ^0.2.2 by query-string 7.1.3, under the Ethereum wallet stack that Privy depends on (@privy-io/react-auth -> x402 -> wagmi -> @wagmi/connectors -> @walletconnect/ethereum-provider 2.21.1, and @reown/appkit 1.7.8, -> @walletconnect/utils). The fix, 0.5.1, is ESM-only and outside ^0.2.2, so overriding it would break query-string's require() of it. Not shipped: a production build of main (2026-10-26, same lockfile) contains none of query-string's or decode-uri-component's code (their option names and decoding table appear in no client or server output), and those wallet libraries load only in the browser (app/src/wallet/privy-bridge.tsx, dynamic(..., { ssr: false })), so even shipped the worst case is a slow tab for the visitor who supplied the input. Cleared when the wallet stack reaches @walletconnect/utils 2.26, which no longer depends on query-string.
app.GHSA-jmr9-qjv8-65gv: extract-zip <=2.0.1, no fixed release. Dev only: lighthouse -> puppeteer. The Lighthouse gate drives the runner's own Chrome through chrome-launcher, so puppeteer never downloads or unpacks a browser. Cleared by lighthouse 13 (a major bump), when taken.
app.GHSA-c475-qrg2-pj4r: basic-ftp 5.3.1, fixed only on the 6.x line. Dev only: lighthouse -> puppeteer -> proxy-agent -> get-uri, which requires ^5. The Lighthouse gate opens no FTP connection. Cleared by lighthouse 13, when taken.

backend/reveal.GHSA-3gc7-fjrx-p6mg: bigint-buffer 1.1.5, no fixed release (unmaintained since 2022; the latest @solana/spl-token still requires it). Reached through Irys and Switchboard -> @solana/spl-token -> @solana/buffer-layout-utils. toBigIntLE runs only when decoding SPL token-account amounts; the daemon moves native SOL, and the one spl-token helper Switchboard calls derives an address and decodes nothing.
